name: g1_carry_backward
title: Carry backward (suction-held payload retreat)
summary: Payload-aware counterpart to g1_walk_backward. The same short reverse footholds are solved with the exact suction hold pose, then the residual policy is adapted with the real 1 kg payload folded into the in-engine plant.

ghost.validator: WARN (all hard gates pass; conservative ankle-roll boundary warning and no recorded baseline)
ghost.notes: 64 bins, -0.083 m/s, exact stance closure, 0/64 infeasible dynamics frames, peak torque 0.46 of limit, exact box-demo cup pose.

train.notes: Trained in-engine with a 1 kg payload on a RunPod RTX A4500 (cloud venue; the shipped champion runs anywhere).

verification.result: Update-free 1 kg payload evaluation: 100% survival, zero falls, forward-frame velocity -0.629 m/s, ghost match 0.940, 0.10 m path error, and 0.06 m lateral drift. Full box-demo handover certification remains pending. Runs on the lambda=0.9 weight-bearing balance harness, not free-standing.
